Third-party aggregator sites report Lite $18, Pro $72, Max $160 per month, but this could not be confirmed by directly reading the vendor's own page content.

Same client-side-rendering issue as z.ai/pricing: the individual tier cards (Lite/Pro/Max) with per-tier pricing and quota were not present in the static HTML fetched; only the page title and meta description (recorded as a claim above) were directly readable.
Request returned an HTTP 302 redirect with no page content; the correct current marketing landing page for Model Studio could not be located and read.

This is Alibaba's official Qwen account on X (Twitter), a third-party platform rather than an Alibaba-owned property, so it was excluded from the claims list on that basis; it was also only seen via a search-engine snippet, not opened and read directly, so per the hard rules it could not be recorded even if the platform were in scope. It claims a 'Qwen Coding Plan' with ~$10/mo Lite and ~$50/mo Pro tiers, which partially overlaps with the verified Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Coding Plan documentation used above, but the exact wording of the tweet was not independently verified by direct page read.
